clock.advancement: integer microseconds; setup frozen; explicit execution schedule only
clock.economic_event: immutable event bytes constructed from declared economic clock before execution
clock.economic_now: wall; ages advance with wall even during stalled source
clock.observer: real monotonic perf_counter_ns; only future paired measurement; never modeled timing
clock.recovery: native latched source-origin+120; persists across restart
clock.residence: wall minus original event time (first_seen only when no event time)
clock.source: fixed finalized block timestamp; never receive-time substitution

construction: all seed and execution bytes fixed before clock.begin; historical availability remains historical
continuity: all linked source receipts; zero unresolved gaps
durable_progress: archive before last source frame; native ledger and source counters; no attempted credit
economic_schedule: historical seed 100x160 at epoch-185+seed_index*.05; execution 120x160 at epoch+index*.05-1
event_timestamp: execution floor(wall_epoch+frame_index*cadence_us/1e6)-1; historical seed fixed epoch-185+seed schedule
finalized_timestamp: historical seed equals original economic clock; fresh empty linked block1100 at epoch; all execution source blocks fresh
floor_assertions: monotonic floor; never delete hot/pinned/unresolved data
native_hot_debt: additional 100x160 native historical transactions from captured templates; full 120x160 execution retained
nonaging_setup: native historical records seeded with declared old availability; current linked empty finalized source established at epoch; no modeled advancement
recovery: first current-native episode latches once; original oldest-record +240 deadline retained; no reenrollment
source_lag_gate: strict <45 for execution; historical seed is not current source authority
stronger_shape: 16000 additional native seed transactions plus unchanged 120x160 execution; no workload reduction
